_comment: ASSUMED walkways, NOT OpenStreetMap data. OSM maps paths around this campus but not the short links between buildings, so routes were up to 17x longer than the straight-line distance. These connectors close the most glaring gaps. They are drawn as dashed amber lines in the app and flagged "assumed": true so they are never mistaken for surveyed data.
_howToVerify: Nobody on the team has walked the campus, so these are inferred from geometry alone: each links two points within 35 m of each other that the network routes 120 m+ around, and none crosses a building footprint. Walk the campus and delete any that do not exist.
_editing: Delete an entry to remove it. Re-run scripts/build-graph.mjs after any change. Removing this file entirely returns the app to pure OSM data.
